stories.title: Springboks out to haunt France again as Boks carry impressive Paris record into showdown
stories.summary: The Springboks are preparing to face France in Paris, carrying an impressive record at Stade de France. They are aiming for a fifth consecutive win at the venue and a fifth victory in the Nations Championship.
stories.angle: This news highlights the Springboks' consistent success and strong performance on the international stage.
